posts.name: Mustafa Foqaha
posts.cooked:
Hi everyone

My name is Mustafa, and I’m looking for small n8n automation projects, freelance tasks, or opportunities to contribute to real-world workflows.

I’ve been learning and building with n8n, AI agents, APIs, and business automation, and I’ve reached the point where I want to move from training and personal projects into solving real problems for real users and businesses.

What I Can Work With

I have hands-on experience with:

  • n8n workflow automation

  • AI Agents

  • Google Gemini

  • WhatsApp integrations

  • Telegram bots & automation

  • Gmail automation

  • Google Sheets

  • REST APIs & Webhooks

  • Google Calendar

  • Web search/API integrations

  • Data processing, routing, conditions, loops, and scheduled workflows

  • Connecting multiple services into one automated workflow

Examples of Workflows I’ve Built

1. WhatsApp AI Assistant

I built a WhatsApp-based AI assistant using n8n that receives incoming messages, processes and routes them based on message type, and sends them to an AI Agent powered by Google Gemini.

The AI Agent can access multiple Google Sheets as tools to retrieve relevant information before generating a response, while memory is used to maintain conversational context.

The response is then automatically sent back to the user through WhatsApp.

image1460×690 57 KB

2. Automated Follow-up & Email Workflow

I built a scheduled automation that reads records from Google Sheets, checks them against specific conditions, loops through the relevant records, and uses an AI Agent to process the information.

The workflow can then update the corresponding Google Sheets records and automatically send emails through Gmail.

This project gave me practical experience with scheduled workflows, conditions, loops, AI processing, spreadsheet operations, and email automation.

image1599×517 42.8 KB

3. Multi-Agent Telegram AI Assistant

I also built a more advanced multi-agent assistant connected to Telegram.

A Supervisor AI Agent receives the user’s request and can work with specialized agents for different tasks, including:

  • Email Agent — reading and sending Gmail messages

  • Search Agent — performing web searches

  • Project Management Agent — retrieving and updating information in Google Sheets

  • Meeting Agent — checking Google Calendar events and creating new events

The system uses Google Gemini models and memory, and the final response is delivered back to the user through Telegram.

This project helped me gain practical experience in designing multi-agent workflows where different AI agents and tools work together to complete a user’s request.

image1594×590 95.4 KB

Certification & Training

I recently completed the AI-Powered Accounting Specialist Program, a 40-hour CPD program provided by Sheets for Financial Training.

The program strengthened my understanding of AI, automation, and their practical applications in accounting, finance, and business processes.

I’ve attached my certificate below.

image563×793 77.5 KB

A Little About Me

My background and interests are not limited to automation itself. I’m especially interested in understanding how a business process works, identifying repetitive manual work, and finding a practical way to automate it.

I’m still building my professional experience with n8n, so I’m not presenting myself as a senior developer.

However, I’m comfortable working independently, researching solutions when I encounter something new, testing different approaches, troubleshooting workflows, and learning along the way.

I care about actually understanding the problem rather than simply connecting nodes together.

What I’m Looking For

Right now, I’m looking for opportunities such as:

  • Small paid n8n projects

  • One-time automation tasks

  • AI Agent integrations

  • API integrations

  • Fixing or improving existing n8n workflows

  • WhatsApp / Telegram automations

  • Gmail & Google Sheets automations

  • Assisting with part of a larger automation project

My main goal is to gain more real-world experience, build a strong portfolio, and deliver useful automations while continuing to improve my n8n skills.

If you have a small project, a workflow that needs fixing, or an automation idea that you need help implementing, feel free to DM me here on the n8n Community.

I’d be happy to hear about what you’re trying to build.

Thanks for reading!

Mustafa
